items.evidence: 26.2 worldgen/sculk.rs decodes catalyst_chance, extra_rare_growths, catalyst (default sculk_catalyst state) and shrieker (default + can_summon=true), and place() implements the full tail, verified line-by-line against the 26.2 jar SculkPatchFeature.place bytecode: nextFloat() <= catalystChance + below collision-full -> catalyst at origin, flag 3; then extraRareGrowths.sample x origin.offset(nextInt(5)-2, 0, nextInt(5)-2) air-above-face-sturdy -> shrieker, flag 3; catalyst roll before the growth sample (same RNG order). canSpreadFrom also matches. The vanilla 26.2 reference world contains no deep dark (0 sculk blocks), so no world-side catalyst count exists to re-measure; the withdrawal rests on the code-vs-jar verification.
items.title: sculk_patch catalyst / extra rare growths tail is implemented in 26.2 (1.21.7 defect withdrawn)

items.evidence: Mechanism root-caused and verified closed. Vanilla 26.2 SnowLayerBlock.canSurvive returns false when the block below is in #cannot_support_snow_layer (jar tag: ice, packed_ice, barrier). The port's Rule::SnowLayer (block_survival.rs) implements the same three steps (deny tag -> allow tag support_override_snow_layer -> face-full collision UP or same-block layers==8), reachable via both block_survives paths, and the 26.2 prepared data contains the tag with exactly the jar's members. SnowAndFreezeFeature.place and Biome.shouldSnow/shouldFreeze match the jar step by step. The snow path is byte-identical between the 1.21.7 and 26.2 trees, so the 1.21.7 +7.6% measurement is not explained by a code difference; the likely explanation is stale prepared tag data on the laptop at generation time (tag_states silently yields an empty set for a missing tag). Caveat: no frozen_peaks biome in the 26.2 reference world and no port world, so the figure cannot be re-measured; live confirmation is B6-H.
items.method: javap + source + prepared data (re-check of 1.21.7 defect)
items.title: Snow-on-packed-ice mechanism verified closed in 26.2 (1.21.7 defect withdrawn)

items.evidence: The 1.21.7 world comparison (2026-11-22, 4,145 paired chunks, both post-decorate) measured water -1.04% underground with surface water matching; never root-caused. This batch did the full noise-based aquifer audit the 1.21.7 batch did not do and found NO divergence: computeFluid (13 SURFACE_OFFSETS, preliminarySurfaceLevel+8, center/above picker logic, minimum over raw surface), computeSurfaceLevel (deep-dark exclusion synthesized from erosion/depth matching OverworldBiomeBuilder.isDeepDarkRegion, clampedMap factor, thresholds -0.3->0.8 flooded / -0.8->0.4 dry), computeRandomizedFluidSurfaceLevel (floorDiv 16/40/16, base floorDiv(y,40)*40+20, spread x10 quantized by 3), computeFluidType (lava gate, |lavaNoise|>0.3), calculatePressure, similarity = 1-(b-a)/25, FLOWING_UPDATE_SIMILARITY = 1-44/25, grid constants, fluid picker. The aquifer code is effectively identical between the 1.21.7 and 26.2 trees (only diff: a test helper's f32->f64 return type). Cannot be re-measured for 26.2 (no port world on the VM); vanilla-side water is 6,227,889 blocks over 6,018 chunks. Status open; measurement deferred to B6-H.
items.method: javap + source (re-check of 1.21.7 defect; full aquifer audit)
items.title: Underground water deficit (-1.04% in 1.21.7) carried over unverified; aquifer core matches the 26.2 jar

items.evidence: Two sites in worldgen/sculk.rs use the WATER_SOURCE flag where vanilla 26.2 tests whether the fluid IS water (any water, including flowing): (1) attempt_spread_vein, Default branch — vanilla regrows the vein when the cursor cell is air OR any water (fluidState.is(WATER)); the port requires a water source. (2) can_place_growth, above-open gate — vanilla accepts air or any water above; the port requires a water source. Verified against the 26.2 jar SculkPatchFeature/SculkSpreader bytecode. Impact confined to sculk patch generation adjacent to flowing water (underground waterfalls / lake edges in the deep dark). No RNG-stream effect (no random calls in either gate). Same root pattern at both sites, so one fix covers both. The rest of the sculk spreader core was verified faithful (constants, post-move 15-block check, all three behaviours, canPlaceGrowth box, onDischarged, valid_movement, MultifaceSpreader equivalence).
items.title: Sculk spreader water gates narrowed to water sources (attempt_spread_vein, can_place_growth)

Adjacent findings NOT recorded as B6 defects: (1) the tag_states silent-empty footgun (missing tag -> empty set, no error) likely explains the 1.21.7 snow measurement; it is a robustness gap in the shared survival loader, not a 26.2 worldgen defect (all tags used here are present in the prepared data); (2) the aquifer deep-dark exclusion synthesis uses double constants -0.225/0.9 where vanilla uses the float-widened -0.22499999403953552/0.8999999761581421 — a ~1e-8 boundary window, negligible; (3) PORT-NOTES item 115 beardifier float-vs-double precision is density-engine-wide debt, recorded not reworked; (4) bubble columns and beds block entities are owned by other batches; (5) the 19 passing-oracle and 14 no-oracle drivers were not run (execution block) — they are unmeasured, not passing.
source: docs/PARITY-SWEEP.md §4 Batch 6 — checks + triage only, no fixes. Scope: noise/density functions, carvers, configured/placed features, structures and structure sets, template pools, biomes and biome sources, chunk generation stages, spawn finding, world presets. Static checks only (javap + source + data diffs + vanilla world census); no cargo builds, no driver runs, no commits.
systemic_note: No single systemic cause across this batch's open defects. B6-G05 is a narrow predicate narrowing (source-flag used for a fluid-is-water test) at two sites in one file, same root pattern. B6-G03 is a measured-but-unroot-caused 1.21.7 divergence whose mechanism was not found in the aquifer core (verified faithful against the 26.2 jar) — if it reproduces for 26.2, the cause lies outside the aquifer. The oracle failures share one pattern: the oracles were written against the 26.3 API and 26.2 moved or never had those packages/signatures (densityfunction, material/rule, Feature ctor, lookup overrides). Decode-coverage is complete (every dispatch arm present) but arm presence is not correctness — B6-G05 was a silent narrowing inside present arms, found only by javap-diffing the feature's gates. Three of four 1.21.7 defects are fixed in the 26.2 tree; the 26.2 port is materially more faithful on worldgen than the 1.21.7 tree was at sweep time.
